!Sample_extract_protocol_ch1 = Total RNA was isolated using a modified protocol of Trizol Reagent and Qiagen RNeasy. Shortly Trizol was added to cell pellets and incubated for 5 minutes at RT, 200µl chloroform was added and 2 minutes incubation at RT, the mixture was centrifuges at 12,000 g for 10 minutes at 4°C. The aqurous phase transfered to a new tube and 100 % ethanol added in 1.25X the volume. Mix well and transfer to mirVana columns and follow the manufacturers instruction from this point.

!Sample_hyb_protocol = Following fragmentation, 15 ug of cRNA were hybridized for 16 hr at 45°C on Affymetrix GeneChip HG-U133 Plus 2.0 array using GeneChip Hybridization Oven 640 according to the manufacturer’s protocol. GeneChips were washed and stained in the Affymetrix Fluidics Station 450.
!Sample_scan_protocol = Gene Chips were scanned using the Affymetrix GeneChip scanner 3000 7G
